areas.label: CI/CD Maturity
areas.evidence_boundary: Repository automation is complete; production approvals, credentials and organization-specific release governance remain operational responsibilities.

areas.label: Dependency Management
areas.evidence_boundary: Locks and audits reduce supply-chain risk; controlled updates still require review and compatibility testing.

areas.label: Reproducible Builds
areas.evidence_boundary: Deterministic packaging is implemented; byte identity also depends on the qualified builder image and source inputs.

areas.label: Containerization
areas.evidence_boundary: The image is hardened and reproducible; registry signing, runtime policies and host security remain deployment concerns.

areas.label: Kubernetes Readiness
areas.evidence_boundary: Manifests are production-oriented; a target-cluster failure, upgrade and restore exercise remains required.

areas.label: Cloud Readiness
areas.evidence_boundary: Portable IaC and service contracts exist; account landing zones, costs and regulated-cloud controls are organization-specific.

areas.label: Horizontal Scalability
areas.evidence_boundary: Stateless services and scaling contracts are implemented; real throughput depends on target infrastructure and workload data.

areas.label: Load Testing
areas.evidence_boundary: Repeatable thresholds and scenarios exist; certified capacity requires execution on production-equivalent infrastructure.

areas.label: Stress Testing
areas.evidence_boundary: Stress, spike and soak profiles are codified; environment-specific breaking points must be measured during qualification.

areas.label: Integration Testing
areas.evidence_boundary: Service contracts are tested in isolation and compose; remote providers still require approved sandbox credentials.

areas.label: Unit Testing
areas.evidence_boundary: Coverage and mutation targets are enforced on critical modules; coverage percentage is not proof of scientific correctness.

areas.label: End-to-End Testing
areas.evidence_boundary: Primary journeys are automated; external scientific systems remain mocked unless a sandbox is explicitly enabled.

areas.label: Browser UI Testing
areas.evidence_boundary: Automated browser journeys cover primary workspaces; browser/device coverage must expand with supported-client policy.

areas.label: Visual Regression Testing
areas.evidence_boundary: Approved semantic and browser baselines protect primary interfaces; new interfaces require deliberate baseline review.

areas.label: Scientific Regression Testing
areas.evidence_boundary: Golden scientific outputs and statistical tolerances protect software behavior; they do not replace independent biological validation.

areas.label: Code Modularity
areas.evidence_boundary: Architecture boundaries are enforced statically; ongoing feature work must preserve module ownership and dependency direction.

areas.label: Code Maintainability
areas.evidence_boundary: Automated quality budgets reduce deterioration; human design review remains necessary for complex scientific workflows.

areas.label: Technical Debt Management
areas.evidence_boundary: Debt is explicit, owned and expiry-controlled; the register must be actively maintained by the delivery team.

areas.label: Documentation Quality
areas.evidence_boundary: Documentation is structured, versioned and tested; operational truth still depends on keeping it synchronized with releases.

areas.label: Developer Experience
areas.evidence_boundary: One-command workflows and a dev container are supplied; local performance depends on the developer workstation.

areas.label: Installation Experience
areas.evidence_boundary: Installers validate supported environments; optional native scientific tools may still require platform-specific packages.

areas.label: Reproducibility
areas.evidence_boundary: Seeds, environments, inputs and outputs are captured; external service availability and licensed datasets remain outside the bundle.

readiness.dual_score_policy: 10/10 is repository implementation readiness, not proof of production capacity or scientific validity.
